Mode.AskContent: This looks like a phone. Phone mode shows your character, chat, journals and compendium in a phone layout, and turns the map off on this device to save battery. You can change this later in Settings.

Character.None: You don't own a character yet. Ask your GM to assign one.

Journal.External: This page type opens in the full journal.

Compendium.Placeholder: Search or browse items, spells, rules…
Compendium.TypeMore: Type at least 2 characters to search.

Turn.ThemeActive: Foundry's combat theme plays its own turn sounds on this device, so the alert sound is skipped. Set Combat Theme to None in Foundry's settings to use this sound instead.

Targets.None: No tokens to target in the active scene.
Targets.Note: Without the map, line of sight isn't checked. Your targets are shown to the GM and on the table screen.

SettingsView.NeedsTableModule: Needs the Awesome VTT module to be active in this world.
SettingsView.WakeLockUnsupported: This browser can't keep the screen on (it needs HTTPS and a recent browser).
SettingsView.HomeScreenIOS: In Safari, tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen".
SettingsView.HomeScreenOther: Open your browser's menu and choose "Add to Home screen" or "Install app".
SettingsView.SeatHint: Where your character sits around the table screen. Picking a taken seat swaps the two characters.

phoneMode.Name: Phone mode
phoneMode.Hint: Show the phone layout on this device. "Ask on phones" asks once on touch devices with a small screen.

disableMap.Name: Turn off the map
disableMap.Hint: While phone mode is on, don't load the map on this device (Foundry's No-Canvas mode). Saves battery and data. Changing this reloads the page.

keepAwake.Name: Keep the screen on
keepAwake.Hint: Stops the screen from dimming or locking while Foundry is open. Needs HTTPS and a supporting browser.

turnAlert.Name: Your-turn alert
turnAlert.Hint: Show a banner when a combatant you own starts its turn.

turnAlertNext.Name: Alert when you're next
turnAlertNext.Hint: Also show a banner when a combatant you own is next in the turn order.

turnAlertVibrate.Name: Vibrate
turnAlertVibrate.Hint: Vibrate on your turn. Supported on Android; iPhones don't allow websites to vibrate.

turnAlertSound.Name: Sound
turnAlertSound.Hint: Sound for your turn. Skipped when Foundry's own Combat Theme is set, which already plays turn sounds.

turnAlertSoundPath.Name: Custom sound file
turnAlertSoundPath.Hint: Path of a sound file on the Foundry server, for the "Custom file" sound.

physicalDice.Name: Physical dice on this phone
physicalDice.Hint: Enter the results of real dice on this phone. Uses the Awesome VTT module's dice entry; its Physical dice setting decides whether the GM enters them instead.

targetList.Name: Phone target list
targetList.Hint: Which tokens of the active scene players can target from their phones. Without the map, Foundry can't check line of sight, so "All" may list creatures a character couldn't see.

homeScreen.Name: Home screen shortcut
homeScreen.Hint: Let players add Foundry to their phone's home screen, opening it full screen with its own icon.

autoDeathSaves.Name: Prompt for death saves
autoDeathSaves.Hint: At the start of your turn in combat, if your character is at 0 HP and neither stable nor dead, ask for the death saving throw straight away.

autoConcentration.Name: Prompt for concentration checks
autoConcentration.Hint: When your concentrating character takes damage, ask for the Constitution saving throw straight away, with the DC dnd5e works out.

autoSaves.Name: Prompt for saving throws
autoSaves.Hint: When a spell or ability that calls for a saving throw targets your character (e.g. a monster's breath weapon), ask for the save with its DC.

autoRequests.Name: Prompt for GM requests
autoRequests.Hint: When the GM asks the party to rest or to make a group check or save (D&D 5e), or asks you for a challenge roll (Shadow of the Demon Lord), ask you to take part straight away.

askBoons.Name: Ask for boons and banes
askBoons.Hint: Shadow of the Demon Lord: rolling an attribute from the sheet first asks how many boons or banes the roll gets, preset to the Next roll choice.

autoInitiative.Name: Prompt to roll initiative
autoInitiative.Hint: When your character joins an encounter without initiative, ask you to roll it (in Shadow of the Demon Lord: to choose a fast or slow turn).

rollToasts.Name: Show roll results
rollToasts.Hint: After you roll (checks, saves, attacks, damage, healing, the dice pool), with Foundry or real dice, show the result for a few seconds, once Dice So Nice has finished, with pass or fail against a DC, and hit or miss if dnd5e shows attack results to players. Blind rolls are not shown. Tap it to dismiss.

autoDamage.Name: Roll damage with attacks
autoDamage.Hint: D&D 5e only: after an attack roll, roll its damage straight away (hit or miss; critical damage on a critical hit). In Shadow of the Demon Lord, roll damage with the attack card's button.

Chat.Mode: Who sees your messages and rolls
Chat.Placeholder: Message, or a command such as /r 1d20

Dice.NextRollHint: Applies to your next d20 roll (checks, saves, skills, attacks, or a d20 below), then goes back to Normal. While it's armed, the pill shows ADV or DIS.
Dice.NextRollHintBoons: Banes (−) on the left, boons (+) on the right. Applies to your next roll (attributes, attacks, spells, or a d20 below), then goes back to 0. While it's armed, the pill shows the number of boons or banes.
Dice.Empty: Tap dice to build a roll

Use.AreaHint: This covers an area. Choose the creatures inside it (the map isn't shown on the phone).
Use.BadBonus: The situational bonus isn't a valid roll formula.
Use.AreaSkipped: The area isn't placed from the phone (the map is off). The GM or the table screen can place it.
Use.SummonsSkipped: The creatures aren't placed from the phone (the map is off). Use Summon on the chat card from the table screen, or ask the GM.
Use.BadModifier: The modifier must be a whole number, such as +1 or -2.

Pill.FavoritesHint: Star actions or items in the Character tab to add them here.

Launcher.Title: Quick actions
Launcher.NoEffects: Nothing to switch on or off right now. Effects such as Rage, Bladesong, or an item's or spell's toggleable effect appear here.
